assumptions: This is the announcement's approximate 43.6 square kilometre scope, not an area recomputed from an official polygon.
announced_coordinated_research_area_sqm.precision_note: Use only as the announced coordinated-research scope until an official polygon is supplied.

assumptions: This is the announcement's approximate 11.4 square kilometre scope and is distinct from the area of the submitted provisional polygon.
announced_overall_design_area_sqm.precision_note: Do not substitute this reported value for a projected-area calculation of geometry/site_boundary.geojson.

assumptions: The three announced component areas are approximate and do not make the repository's provisional key-area polygons official.
announced_key_detailed_design_area_sqm.precision_note: Use for announcement-scope reporting only; recompute submitted polygons independently.

assumptions: The required identifiers are zhongzhiyuan_ai_acceleration_area, beijing_ai_origin_community, and dazhongsi_ai_industry_cluster.
This is the projected area of the submitted provisional constraint, not an official or survey-grade site area.
site_area_sqm.precision_note: The value is reproducible from the submitted geometry in EPSG:4548 but must not replace the announcement's approximate 11.4 square kilometre scope.
site_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Any replacement or edit of geometry/site_boundary.geojson, especially receipt of an official polygon.

assumptions: The four conceptual functional bands are a gap-free, non-overlapping partition in the submitted WGS84 topology and are not statutory land-use parcels.
land_use_partition_area_sqm.precision_note: The 7.455 square metre difference from site_area_sqm is projection-segmentation tolerance, about 0.000065 percent, not a claimed physical gap or overlap.
land_use_partition_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Any edit to geometry/land_use.geojson or geometry/site_boundary.geojson.

assumptions: The participant building layer is provisional concept geometry, not a cleared existing-building survey or an approved development plan.
building_footprint_area_sqm.precision_note: This is only the summed footprint of reversible concept prototypes; it does not establish existing or approved floor area, height, ownership, or density.
building_footprint_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Any edit to geometry/buildings.geojson or geometry/site_boundary.geojson.

assumptions: The approved FAR denominator, official development parcels, and approved total floor area are absent.
floor_area_ratio.reason: No approved FAR control is present; the proposal must not infer one from provisional geometry.
floor_area_ratio.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of approved regulatory planning conditions and official parcel geometry.

assumptions: Concept building geometry is not a verified existing-building survey or an approved development plan.
building_density.reason: Approved building-density controls and verified building footprints are unavailable.
building_density.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of cleared building footprints, official parcels, and approved density controls.

assumptions: The final green-space design layer is participant-controlled and remains provisional.
green_space_area_sqm.precision_note: This is the area of nine microclimate interface prototypes, not existing park green area or an approved green-space control.
green_space_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Any edit to geometry/green_space.geojson or geometry/site_boundary.geojson.

assumptions: The ratio will describe submitted proposal geometry only and must not be presented as an approved planning control.
green_ratio.precision_note: The ratio describes only submitted microclimate prototype area divided by the provisional research-index polygon; it is not an existing or statutory green ratio.
green_ratio.recalculation_trigger: Any edit to the site boundary or green-space layer, or receipt of an official green-ratio control.

assumptions: The public-space layer represents a concept proposal rather than surveyed ownership or approved public land.
public_space_area_sqm.precision_note: This is the area of nine candidate public-interface envelopes, not surveyed public ownership or an approved dedication.
public_space_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Any edit to geometry/public_space.geojson or geometry/site_boundary.geojson.

assumptions: The ratio is a proposal-geometry indicator and does not establish land ownership, dedication, or statutory public-space control.
public_space_ratio.precision_note: The ratio describes only candidate interface envelopes divided by a provisional research-index polygon; it is not a statutory public-space ratio.
public_space_ratio.recalculation_trigger: Any edit to the site boundary or public-space layer.

assumptions: A road centreline cannot establish road-area ratio, road redlines, engineering width, or implementation alignment.
road_area_ratio.reason: Official road redlines and final road polygons are unavailable.
road_area_ratio.recalculation_trigger: Receipt of official road redlines or creation of a cleared, width-supported road polygon layer.

assumptions: Phasing areas are conditional concept gates, not a government programme, funding promise, or fixed construction schedule.
phasing_area_sqm.precision_note: This is the summed envelope of four conceptual condition gates, not a construction area, programme, budget, or approved schedule.
phasing_area_sqm.recalculation_trigger: Any edit to geometry/phasing.geojson or its prerequisite conditions.

assumptions: This count describes synthetic offline fixtures only and is not a field sample or service performance result.
Each synthetic negative fixture is expected to stop or hand off; the count is not a field incident rate.
The field trial is not authorized and has not run; performance_results must remain null.
t1_field_performance.reason: No authorized field trial, population, baseline, or observation exists.
t1_field_performance.recalculation_trigger: Only after authorization, pre-registration, field execution, and independent human review.
